safety_warnings: The IOREF pin on the JANALOG header is connected to the 3.3 V rail (PWR_3P3V) and is provided as a reference/output for shields. It is not to be used to feed power back into the board.

A0 (PA4) and A1 (PA5) on the JANALOG header are direct STM32U585 ADC inputs referenced to VREF+. They are not 5 V-tolerant. Valid input range is 0-VREF+ (≈3.3 V). The absolute maximum at the pin is VDD + 0.3 V, approximately 3.6 V. Above this level, the MCU's internal protection diodes begin to conduct. Do not apply 5 V to A0 or A1.
extracted_info.additional_context: The 3.3 V system rail (PWR_3P3V) is generated by a step-down (buck) converter from the PWR_3P8V rail, which in turn is derived from the 5V_SYS bus. The 5V_SYS bus is a diode-OR combination of the USB-C VBUS and the 7-24 V buck output. The PWR_3P3V supplies the STM32U585 microcontroller, the ANX7625 (3.3 V rails), the Wi-Fi® 3.3 V domain, and the 3.3 V header pins. The Power LED (D27201) is tied to the 3.3 V rail and illuminates when the board is powered.
